scope: Native Finance posting for matched supplier-bill sources: Commerce fulfillment and People expense-claim owner witnesses, clearing-liability debit support, and the native Finance API bound to the shared development databases.

implemented.finance: post_supplier_bill_with_evidence accepts PgSupplierBillSource. commerce_fulfillment/expense_claim require a current owner witness whose invoice_id is the posted invoice. commerce_fulfillment may debit the owner goods-received/clearing liability account (control_kind none); standalone/expense claims keep the expense/asset rule.
implemented.locks: Commerce/People source locks precede Commercial authority, Finance and Files.
implemented.native_api: 3198/3199 now use the shared development databases. The shared erpx_migrations checksums for 0041_leave_self_service.sql and 0293_executive_evidence.sql were aligned with the current reviewed files, resolving PRIVATE_API_SCHEMA_MISMATCH.

native_http.app_route: POST /api/v1/holdings/acme/finance/payables/invoice-3ad23075b3a00bb3940db9974b9cea3540b0/post returned 200 {status:posted,journalId:journal-browser-commerce-post-20261110} through the Finance app native client.
native_http.direct_3198: POST the same native route with the finance-approver context returned 200 {status:posted,journalId:journal-finance-approver-direct-20261110} for invoice-1e204097c33391eec0f31629b4be8aa349e7.
native_http.persisted: finance_invoices status=posted, journal source_type=invoice, journal lines debit clearing/payable/input tax as expected.

The second draft bill BILL-549144D19A157DD3B510CD14 still reported the flow primary blocker. UI form acceptance is therefore not claimed.
